facility.name: Happy Kidz Learning Center #2
facility.programs_provided: School Age Care,Before School Care,Meals Provided ,After School Care,Snacks Provided,Drop-In Care,Part Time Care

provenance.note: Census Geocoder Exact match: 410 VALLEY HI DR, SAN ANTONIO, TX, 78227

inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Interact positively with children: During the investigation, it was determined that a caregiver did not interact positively with a child in care. Note: This was corrected when the caregiver was terminated.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Interact positively with children (26 TAC §746.1203(5))

occurrences.finding: Required Documentation for Unitary Surfacing Materials: The operation did not have the required documentation for the impact rating of the unitary surfacing material used on the playground.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Documentation for Unitary Surfacing Materials (26 TAC §746.4913)

occurrences.finding: Children Handwashing After Toileting or Diapering: A caregiver did not wash a child's hands after changing their diaper.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children Handwashing After Toileting or Diapering (26 TAC §746.3417(3))

occurrences.finding: Diapering Procedures - Sanitizing Diaper Changing Area: A caregiver did not sanitize the changing table after changing a child's diaper.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diapering Procedures - Sanitizing Diaper Changing Area (26 TAC §746.3505(e))

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two: During the investigation, it was learned that children under the age of two years old watch television in the mornings at drop off.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two (26 TAC §746.2207(a))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - No Harsh, Cruel or Unusual: Based on information gathered for this investigation, a caregiver used a harsh and inappropriate tone of voice when disciplining a child.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - No Harsh, Cruel or Unusual (26 TAC §746.2805)

occurrences.finding: Incident/Illness Report Form Shared with Parent: Based on the information gathered, the parent was not provided with an incident report.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Incident/Illness Report Form Shared with Parent (26 TAC §746.707)

occurrences.finding: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk: Based on information gathered for this investigation, the director failed to notify CCR about a non-routine situation that risked harming a child.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk (26 TAC §746.305(a)(6))

occurrences.finding: AP Background ck determination - If provisionally eligible w/conditions or eligible w/conditions you must restrict duties per conditions/restrictions: A caregiver counted in ratio in the Older Infant classroom did not have Eligible results to be counted in ratio. Note: This was corrected at inspection when an additional caregiver was placed in the room with the caregiver.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background ck determination - If provisionally eligible w/conditions or eligible w/conditions you must restrict duties per conditions/restrictions (26 TAC §745.635(3))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: During the course of this investigation, it was found that the owner demonstrated poor judgment by asking a parent not to bring their child to daycare for two weeks in an attempt to obtain a better inspection grade from another agency.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Suspension and Expulsion: Based on the information gathered during this investigation, it was discovered that the operation does not have a formal suspension policy in place and did not adhere to its operational policy when suspending a child from attending daycare for two weeks.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Suspension and Expulsion (26 TAC §746.501(a)(8))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training - Caregivers of Children Under 24 Months Required: Training record on SID's for the required staff were not received.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training - Caregivers of Children Under 24 Months Required (26 TAC §746.1309(d))

occurrences.finding: Transportation Safety Training -Director and Employee Complete 2 Hours Annually: Transportation training for the director was not submitted for review as requested.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Transportation Safety Training -Director and Employee Complete 2 Hours Annually (26 TAC §746.1316(a))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training - Caregivers of Children Under 24 Months Required: Two out five staff files did not have SID's training available for review at the time of inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training - Caregivers of Children Under 24 Months Required (26 TAC §746.1309(d))

occurrences.finding: Transportation Safety Training -Director and Employee Complete 2 Hours Annually: The director did not have transportation training available for review at the time of inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Transportation Safety Training -Director and Employee Complete 2 Hours Annually (26 TAC §746.1316(a))

occurrences.finding: Diaper Changing Equipment - Hand-washing Sink in Diaper Changing Area: In the 18-24 month old room, there was no handwashing sink in the diaper changing area.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diaper Changing Equipment - Hand-washing Sink in Diaper Changing Area (26 TAC §746.3503(d))

occurrences.finding: First Aid Kit - Incomplete Kit: The first-aid kit used in the transportation vehicle was missing the following items: thermometer, gloves, tweezers, and scissors.
occurrences.violation_type_title: First Aid Kit - Incomplete Kit (26 TAC §746.4003(a))

occurrences.finding: AP Parental Notification of Deficiency as described in 746.309 within 5 Days: The operation had not notified parents of their violations regarding infant safe sleep and abuse/neglect investigation findings.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Parental Notification of Deficiency as described in 746.309 within 5 Days (26 TAC §746.311(a))

occurrences.finding: Posting Requirements - Letter or form from the most recent Licensing Inspection or Investigation: The most recent investigation letter was not posted in the daycare. The most recent posted form was from April 2024.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Posting Requirements - Letter or form from the most recent Licensing Inspection or Investigation (26 TAC §746.401(2))

occurrences.finding: Diaper Changing Equipment - No Play or Eating Surfaces Used: In the 18-24 month old room, there is no area for diaper changing area that is away from children's play areas or centers.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diaper Changing Equipment - No Play or Eating Surfaces Used (26 TAC §746.3503(b))

occurrences.finding: Active Play Surfacing In Use Zones - Loose Fill or Unitary Surfacing: A Step 2 Clubhouse Climber on the playground did not have loose fill surfacing under it.  The climber was observed to be installed over concrete.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Active Play Surfacing In Use Zones - Loose Fill or Unitary Surfacing (26 TAC §746.4901(a))

occurrences.finding: Personal use of electronic devices, such as cell phones, MP3 players, tablets, and video games: Video footage obtained shows a caregiver scrolling on her phone while supervising a group of napping children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Personal use of electronic devices, such as cell phones, MP3 players, tablets, and video games (26 TAC §746.1203(3)(D))

occurrences.finding: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device: Video footage reviewed shows an infant was asleep in a swing for approximately 8 minutes.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device (26 TAC §746.2426(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: Video footage showed the 2 year old caregiver stepping out of the classroom leaving napping children unattended.  Video footage of the infant room shows an infant caregiver asleep while feeding a child leaving the children unsupervised.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: AP Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Ensure No Child Abused, Neglected, or Exploited: This standard was found deficient as part of a DFPS Investigation
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Ensure No Child Abused, Neglected, or Exploited (26 TAC §746.1201(4))

occurrences.finding: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment -Use of Safety Straps: An infant was observed not in the safety straps when in an elevated toddler table.       Note: This was corrected at inspection when the infant was buckled in.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment -Use of Safety Straps (26 TAC §746.2407)

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pediatric First Aid with Rescue Breathing: One out of the three staff files reviewed during inspection still does not have current First Aid and CPR training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pediatric First Aid with Rescue Breathing (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(3)(A))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Transportation training: A caregiver was observed transporting the children in care and still does not have transportation training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Transportation training (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(7)(A))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Transportation training: A caregiver was observed transporting the children in care and does not have transportation training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Transportation training (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(7)(A))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pediatric First Aid with Rescue Breathing: One out of the three staff files reviewed during inspection did not have current First Aid and CPR training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pediatric First Aid with Rescue Breathing (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(3)(A))

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Safety Documentation for Emergency Drills, Fire Extinguishers, & Smoke Detectors: Safety Documentation for Emergency Drills were not available for review during inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Safety Documentation for Emergency Drills, Fire Extinguishers, & Smoke Detectors (26 TAC §746.801(10))

occurrences.finding: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Keep Separate from Food and Inaccessible to Children: Cleaning products such as diluted bleach spray bottle and sanitizing wipes were accessible to the children in care as they observed within reach in the classroom and in the unlocked children's bathroom cabinet.     Note: This was corrected at inspection as the cleaning products were removed and placed out of reach.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Keep Separate from Food and Inaccessible to Children (26 TAC §746.3407(12))

occurrences.finding: Director present-Minimum 75%: The Director is only present a total of 20 hours per week instead of the required 30 hours per week.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director present-Minimum 75% (26 TAC §746.1011(a))

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months: The operation did not have a current fire inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: Four caregivers were observed caring for children without a background check.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: The infant classroom and the three year old room were observed out of ratio.     Note: Ratios were corrected when other caregivers arrived  at the operation and stepped into the classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Emergency Telephone Numbers for Each Child: The operation has been transporting children without the required emergency telephone numbers.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Emergency Telephone Numbers for Each Child (26 TAC §746.5617(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Transportation training: A caregiver was observed transporting the children in care and does not have transportation training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Transportation training (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(7)(A))

occurrences.finding: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Emergency Medical Information: Children have been transported without the required medical authorization.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Emergency Medical Information (26 TAC §746.5617(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Notification of Additional Services Offered: The operation did not notify CCR of adding transportation services.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Notification of Additional Services Offered (26 TAC §746.301(7))

occurrences.finding: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Fire Extinguisher: The vehicle used to transport the children in care did not contain the required fire extinguisher.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Fire Extinguisher (26 TAC §746.5617(a)(5))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: A care giver's purse and disinfectant wipes were observed accessible to the children in care.     Note: They were removed out of children's reach during inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)

occurrences.finding: AP Cribs - Only Snug Fitting Sheet and Crib Mattress Cover Allowed if Infant Younger than 12 Months of Age: A bopy pillow and a bib were observed in the crib where a three month old slept.     Note: The boppy pillow was moved during inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Cribs - Only Snug Fitting Sheet and Crib Mattress Cover Allowed if Infant Younger than 12 Months of Age (26 TAC §746.2415(b))

occurrences.finding: Parental Notification of Less Serious Injuries: Parents were not notified of a less serious injury a child sustained while in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Parental Notification of Less Serious Injuries (26 TAC §746.307(c))

occurrences.finding: Maximum Group Size 13 or More Children: The director was found supervising both the preK class of 6 children and the toddler class of 18 children with SAG of 2 years totaling 24 children to one caregiver.     This was corrected during inspection as staff reported for their shifts within 20 minutes, three caregivers arrived for PreK, and two toddler classrooms.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maximum Group Size 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1609)

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: The infant classroom was found over ratio by 2 infants. Caregiver was caring for 6 infants with specified age group of 10 months.  The child:caregiver ratio for this class is 1:4.  The director was found supervising both the preK class of 6 children and the toddler class of 18 children with SAG of 2 years totaling 24 children to one caregiver.     This was corrected during inspection as staff reported for their shifts within 20 minutes and the director was able to join the caregiver in the infant classroom. Three caregivers arrived for PreK, and two toddler classrooms.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Controlling Person - Submit Controlling Person Form to Licensing within two days after a person becomes a controlling person. See TAC 745.901: The operation has  not removed the previous director from the controlling list.  The previous director was inactivated in Oct/2022.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Controlling Person - Submit Controlling Person Form to Licensing within two days after a person becomes a controlling person. See TAC 745.901 (26 TAC §745.903(2))

occurrences.finding: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Keep Separate from Food and Inaccessible to Children: The under-sink cabinets in the restrooms contained lysol and cleaning products that are accessible to children.  There are no security latches for the cabinet doors.     This was corrected when all supplies were taken out and placed in a locked cabinet/storage.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Keep Separate from Food and Inaccessible to Children (26 TAC §746.3407(12))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Play Materials and Equipment Safe: Three large toy trucks were observed to be broken with jagged edges.    This was corrected at inspection when a caregiver removed all three from the playground area.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Play Materials and Equipment Safe (26 TAC §746.3701(5))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Medical Authorization
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Special Needs Statement (26 TAC §746.605(12))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Health Statement
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Health Statement (26 TAC §746.603(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Activities for Infants - Not in Restrictive Device for more than 15 Minutes: An infant was observed sitting in a bouncer seat for longer than the allowed time frame of 15 minutes.    NOTE:  This was corrected at inspection when infant was pulled out of bouncer and placed on floor to continue.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Activities for Infants - Not in Restrictive Device for more than 15 Minutes (26 TAC §746.2417(2)(B))

occurrences.finding: Smoke Detectors Testing: The operation did not have a documented record of monthly smoke detector/carbon monoxide tests conducted.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Smoke Detectors Testing (26 TAC §746.5319)

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months: Recite: The operation did not have a current  fire inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))
